decoder.buildStatus: inferred schema version; not independently verified game client build

masks.method: Mandatory pinned full component masks; exact anchor tile or rotated cardinal footprint perimeter within placement base chunk; source plane checked using paste translation.

schema.sourceIdentity: ID source prefix reconstructed from SHA256([sourceMinor,objectId,sourcePlane,sourceX%64,sourceY%64,sourceType,rotation,sourceOrdinal]) first24 hex. Rotation is the unchanged source-use rotation; map layouts translate without rotating.

limits: Build 950 is inferred decoder compatibility, not a verified live-game build.
Name and action classify static scenery; membership flags do not certify geographic F2P access or server interaction.
Generic Tree/Rocks stay untyped; no model equivalence or product type is invented.
Conditional resources require every encoded leaf present with identical classes and footprint; renderer default alone is insufficient.
Divine, portable, temporary and player-created definition prefixes are review templates, never ordinary static-resource grants.
Exact tile/perimeter witnesses establish spatial correspondence, not server interaction or travel; multiple components remain explicit.
No upper-plane or underground contents are included: no certified entrance/landing topology was available.
Missing resource or layout is not a verified deletion; unwitnessed and unmatched retained declarations remain review evidence.
Witnesses remain within the placement base chunk; an outside-base perimeter tile cannot grant a resource in either chunk.
Pinned surface corrections exclude invalid regions and nonwalking components before attachment; rejected exact candidates remain review evidence.
